comment: Really great teacher and conducted an interesting class that kept student generally engaged. Willing to work with you if you run into issues. Psych/econ based but overall pretty accessible to student not familiar with the subjects. Has a super interesting life story and sense of humor.

Harwell has been one of my favorite professors in the Jepson School. I went into her Behavioral and Experimental Economics class knowing literally nothing about econ, but she made it easy to understand. She also does experiments in class where we get paid real money. Lectures were interesting, only 3 five-page papers and she's literally hilarious!
Absolutely love Harwell and her class. By far the best professor I've ever had and the most interesting class I've ever taken. If you can get in take this class!!!
She is the bomb. Best professor ever. If you go through the leadership major or minor without taking Dr. Harwell you absolutely missed out.

Amazing professor! The main substance of your grade will be participation, the midterm, and the final (which was one paper, a group presentation, and a written final). The class itself is super interesting, and Dr. Harwell is amazing and cares a lot about her students! Her expectations are clear and she is always willing to engage with students!

Harwell was one of the best professors I've had at UR. She is extremely fair and she makes the information actually very interesting. I'm not even a leadership major but it was my favorite class I've had in my time at UR.
You want Harwell, plain and simple. Best professor I've ever had and probably ever will. If you have the chance to take her chance, do not think twice

Dr. Harwell is a hilarious and caring woman and is the IDEAL teacher. She believes in no pop quizzes, no cold calling, TONS of interactive activities and a participative class. She knows that we are students under pressure and grades us/ gives us online quizzes accordingly. Her readings are mostly compelling page-turners and getting an A is easy.

Dr. Harwell is a very good professor. She cares about her students and truly wants them to learn and succeed. She is entertaining, funny and does not put you to sleep. She uses many methods including readings from popular books, videos, projects, and experiments. I enjoyed going to her class and look forward to taking another class from her.

Dr. Harwell is a great professor. The classroom environment is laid back but productive. She is clear about grading and it's not hard to do well if you follow the directions. Some assigned reading for each class but it's talked about in class discussion. She's extremely friendly and listens to any feedback. Highly recommend.

Super nice woman likes to take students' opinions into consideration when asked how to teach a class. Decent amount of reading but nothing too bad, pretty easy grader, overall a chill and understanding professor. Would definitely recommend.
